verses.1: And Abraham went up from Egypt, along with his wife and all who belonged to him. They were accompanied by their donkey.
verses.2: And Abraham was extremely proud of his possessions, both in silver and gold.
verses.3: And he went along his journey from Minogev to Bethel, all the way to the place where his tent was located at first. That place was between Bethel and Ai.
verses.4: To the place where the altar was built, and where Abraham called out to God’s name.
verses.5: And also, Laban, who took Abram as his wife, was also a shepherd and a sheperd.
verses.6: And I will not let them live together on this land, because their possessions were too many for them to live together.
verses.7: And there was a dispute between the people of Abraham’s property and those who owned land from Lot. The Canaanites and Perizzites also became involved in this dispute. Then they settled in that land.
verses.8: And Abraham said to Lot, “Let there be no strife between me and you, and between your people and my people. For we are all brothers.”
verses.9: Now, the entire earth is before you. Please separate it from above, from the sky and its threats. And also from the right side and its dangers.
verses.10: And he lifted his eyes and saw all the cities of the Jordan, for they were all filled with water. It was like a garden of God, just as the land of Egypt was before God’s judgment.
verses.11: And he chose Lot as his successor. Then Lot set out from there, and each of them separated from their brothers.
verses.12: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the towns of the Kikkar. They lived there until the time of Sodom.
verses.13: And the people of Sodom are evil and sinners before Jehovah.
verses.14: And Jehovah said to Abraham, “After you were separated from your family, look out from that place where you are now. See what is happening there: whether it’s good or bad.”
verses.15: For all the land that you see, I will give it to you and your descendants for ever.
verses.16: And I have scattered your seeds over the earth. If anyone can drain the earth’s water, then your seeds will also be drained away.
verses.17: He walked across the land, from one end to the other, for it is you who have given me this land.
verses.18: And Abraham went there, and he sat down in Elon Mamre, which was near his home. There, he built an altar for Yahweh.
